BiblicalUsage: A dunghill is what a disobedient man's house becomes. Darius decrees that anyone who alters the word shall have timber pulled from his house and his house made a dunghill, and Nebuchadnezzar threatens the same against the wise men who cannot tell his dream.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the dunghill is the king's way of saying the house is fit for nothing now — disobedience turns a dwelling into refuse.
